_about: How hard the game is (GameState.difficulty), picked when naming the restaurant and changed in Settings. Hard can only be picked once hard_unlock_day is done (GameState.day_number). For each level: closeup_pace speeds up the timed close-ups (how fast food cooks on the stove and in the oven, and how fast batter pours: under 1 gives more time to flip, plate, bake and stop pouring), pay multiplies what customers pay (on top of service.json pay_scale), arrival_interval multiplies the gap between walk-ins (over 1 is fewer), and patience multiplies how long customers wait for their food (the WaitRing, and what counts as quick service).
hard_unlocked_news: Hard mode unlocked! Pick it in Settings for less time, less pay and busier days.
